description: This is a Go source file implementing a command-line tool for creating archive files of templates, including reading version info, packaging directories into zip archives, and handling errors.

classes.name: archiveVersion
classes.description: Struct representing the archive version info with version number and date.

classes.name: appConfig
classes.description: Struct holding configuration parameters for the application, including directory, output filename, and verbose flag.

classes.name: errUnsupportedVersion
classes.description: Custom error type indicating an unsupported archive version.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function parsing flags, validating input, and initiating archive build process.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates the archive zip file, writes version info, and processes each board directory.

methods.name: getVersionFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the version.json file, validates version range.

methods.name: writeBoard
methods.description: Copies board files into the archive, including jsonl and other files.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Copies individual files into the zip archive, with verbose output.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Method for errUnsupportedVersion to generate error message string.
